title: Nacos MCP Version Storage Descriptor Schema v1
description: Points one MCP AI Resource Version to its existing Server and optional Tools and Resources Config objects without copying or extending their payloads.

ServerStorageKey.description: The built-in provider splits only the first two colons and treats the remainder as the Config data id.

McpVersionStorageDescriptor.description: Points to the existing MCP Config objects without copying or changing their bytes. serverKey is required; optional content keys are omitted rather than serialized as null.
